strings.name: Barbra Streisand
strings.summary: Streisand moved from New York clubs and Broadway into records, television and film, winning an acting Oscar for Funny Girl. She sought artistic control and directed, acted, co-wrote and produced Yentl, continuing across media. Her public work includes women’s health and equality advocacy. She published a memoir in 2023 and received Cannes’ honorary Palme in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: As singer, actor and director, her musical-theater and filmmaking work advanced women’s creative autonomy in the American entertainment industry.
